name: Embedded Deformation (Stage I)
definition: A mechanism to apply ARAP deformation over geometry representations (meshes, point clouds, particles) using a deformation graph of control nodes, each associated with an affine transformation (3x3 matrix A and 3x1 translation t).
summary: Embedded Deformation (Stage I) applies ARAP geometric deformation to 3D Gaussian Splatting via control nodes, estimating per-Gaussian affine transformations to mitigate visual artifacts from geometry-radiance field mismatches.
